item.description: PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street) now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 4110009.

item.title: Correction · PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street): The plaza page now describes the 2017…

Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf; https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/pier-70-parcel-k-north.

item.description: The 20th Street Plaza's caveat no longer says its edges match PKN's, and no longer says no Assessor lot is under it. Source: Pier & Point's overlay of the outline on DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 4110009 and 4110012.

item.title: Correction · PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street): The map notes now use the D4D's name '20th…
item.description: The map notes now use the D4D's name '20th Street Plaza' with its 0.5-acre area and program instead of saying no name was found, and say the plaza sits on the Port's Illinois & 20th Street Parcel outside Brookfield's site. The maintenance-funding fact lists only what Port Item 9B names, the Port page is quoted as written, the summary says no source reports the plaza built, and image credits no longer name design firms the figure does not credit or say 'adopted 2017'. The place's name in the map key is unchanged. The D4D citation no longer calls it an 'adopted' document. Source: Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 SUD Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Parcel K North project page (https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/pier-70-parcel-k-north).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 SUD Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Parcel K North project page (https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/pier-70-parcel-k-north)

item.title: Added · PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street): Pier 70’s 20th Street frontage open space added…
item.description: Pier 70’s 20th Street frontage open space added, the first of several previously untracked open spaces to be added. The event date is the Planning Commission's Aug 24, 2017 approval of the Pier 70 D4D that defines the space (Resolution 19980). Source: Pier 70 Design for Development; Port Item 9B (Sep 22, 2017).
item.source: Pier 70 Design for Development; Port Item 9B (Sep 22, 2017)

item.title: Milestone · PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street): Planning's Parcel K North design… (Nov 13, 2019)
item.description: Planning's Parcel K North design approval covers the vertical improvement; the Port's project page says the project 'will also include a 20th St/Illinois St Plaza and improvements to Michigan St.' (Nov 13, 2019). Source: SF Planning Department, 2019-11-22; Port of San Francisco.
item.source: SF Planning Department, 2019-11-22; Port of San Francisco

item.title: Milestone · PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street): Port Commission meeting at which… (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission meeting at which Resolution 17-52 was scheduled for adoption; its recitals state the Port 'intends to vacate an approximately 12' portion of Michigan Street ... and then subdivide the resulting merged parcel into four new parcels: the Plaza Parcel, Parcel K North, the 21st Street right-of-way extension parcel, and Parcel K South' (the recitals state an intent; this record has not read a source showing the subdivision was carried out) (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Planned · PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street): SF Planning Commission adopts the… (Aug 24, 2017)
item.description: SF Planning Commission adopts the Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development (D4D) by Resolution No. 19980; the Port Commission's Item 9B staff report from the same period (approvals adopted Sep 26, 2017) names the '20th Street Plaza' among the Illinois Street Parcels' infrastructure obligations alongside Michigan Street and Irish Hill Park (Aug 24, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.
